Carrier checks on a quiet handover
This page teaches why careful pet handovers matter at Aurelia Skyways and how the Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps each step calm, clear, and recorded. New staff should treat every note as part of the travel trail, because small details protect comfort, safety, and trust from booking through pickup.

When a traveler arrives, greet them in a warm professional tone and keep the conversation simple. Confirm the pet's travel documents, watch for obvious concerns with the carrier, and pass any special notes to the crew without delay. The goal is not to rush but to make sure the right people have the right information before departure.

Records aide: <<FACT F050>> and then note the carrier condition, the pet's visible state, and any care items handed over. Keep the wording plain and factual. If a traveler seems anxious, steady the exchange by speaking slowly and showing that the desk is following the same process every time.

On the return side, meet the pickup with the same care. Check that the carrier matches the record, confirm the handover details, and flag anything unusual at once. Records aide: <<FACT F046>> so the notes stay consistent across the journey. If a crew note mentions feeding, rest, or cleaning, copy it exactly into the file and share it with the next staff member.

The main habit to build is clear handoff discipline. Listen first, write what matters, and avoid adding guesswork. That keeps the desk reliable for travelers, crews, and the animals in our care.

Remember: calm handling, exact notes, and steady handovers are the standard.
